assignments.description: Adds 1 to the Account's running Opportunity count.
assignments.name: Increment_Account_Count
assignments.label: Increment Account Count

Flow.description: Triggers before an Opportunity with an Account is deleted (entry criteria on Start: AccountId is not null). Salesforce only supports before-delete for record-triggered flows, and the Opportunity being deleted still exists at this point, so the raw related-Opportunity count is taken and reduced by 1 (floored at 0) before writing back to Account.Number_of_Opportunities__c. Fault handling: a before-delete flow cannot update the Opportunity being deleted, so the Opportunity.Description fault path used by the AFTER flow is not possible here; a fault in this flow fails the delete with the flow error. Known limit: if several Opportunities on the same Account are deleted in one transaction, each interview subtracts only 1. Companion flow: Opportunity - AFTER - Update Account Opportunity Count handles create/reparent.

formulas.description: Raw count minus 1 for the Opportunity being deleted, floored at 0.
formulas.name: formulaN_CountAfterDelete

Flow.interviewLabel: Opportunity - BEFORE - Update Account Opportunity Count {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: Opportunity - BEFORE - Update Account Opportunity Count

loops.description: Tallies the count in a variable only. No Get/Create/Update/Delete Records inside this loop.
loops.name: Loop_Account_Opportunities
loops.label: Loop Through Account's Opportunities

recordLookups.description: Single bulk-safe query for every Opportunity on the deleted Opportunity's Account, including the one being deleted. Only Id is retrieved.
recordLookups.name: Get_Account_Opportunities
recordLookups.label: Get Account's Opportunities

recordUpdates.description: Writes the count, less the Opportunity being deleted, to the Account. No fault path: before-delete flows cannot update the deleted Opportunity, so a fault fails the delete.
recordUpdates.name: Update_Account
recordUpdates.label: Update Account

variables.description: Opportunities (Id only) on the Account. Used only to tally the count.
variables.name: colAccountOpportunities

variables.description: Running raw count of Opportunities on the Account, including the one being deleted.
variables.name: varN_AccountOpportunityCount
